statusText: EA_ON / green: NQ is closed and Tail remains low while Gulf escalation keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening remains the main conditional Tail checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress ahead of Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed, so no live one-way path is observable. Saudi and Gulf equities weakened after Houthi attack claims, while energy and rate sensitivity keep Stress extreme. Tail remains low until the reopening gap and retracement structure become observable.

lookbackSummary: Prior 24 UTC hours: Tail 12-16% and Stress 85-93%; every published slot was green / EA_ON with dominant mode normal.
outlookSummary: NQ remains closed until 22:00 UTC Sunday. Conditional WATCH is concentrated around the reopen through 00:00 UTC, when gap size, retracement quality and repeated extension become observable.

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed; weaker Saudi and Gulf equities raise Stress, but no live NQ path shows persistent one-way extension or failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: If no fresh geopolitical discontinuity appears, the final pre-open phase should remain high-Stress but below the WATCH Tail threshold.

forecast.analysis: The final pre-open hour carries the highest closed-market uncertainty; Tail remains below WATCH until the opening gap and retracement quality become observable.
drivers: Opening gap and first retracement remain unobserved

forecast.analysis: At the scheduled Globex reopen, WATCH is conditional on the actual gap, first retracement depth and whether extension repeats instead of mean reverting.

forecast.analysis: During the second reopening hour, WATCH remains conditional on failed pullbacks or repeated extension; orderly two-way trade would argue for lower Tail.
Conditional WATCH persists while the reopening structure matures; meaningful retracements and declining directional efficiency would reduce Tail quickly.
If the first three reopening hours establish two-way price discovery and meaningful retracements, Tail should fall below WATCH despite still-high Stress.
drivers: Stress can remain high without pathological Tail

forecast.analysis: If no repeated extension develops, the overnight structure should become less path-dependent and Tail should remain low while headline sensitivity persists.
If overnight pullbacks remain functional and cross-assets do not align directionally, the regime should stay low-Tail with elevated residual Stress.
drivers: Cross-asset alignment remains a conditional test

forecast.analysis: If Asia-session price discovery remains balanced, Tail should stay low; any renewed Saudi escalation would primarily lift Stress unless NQ structure aligns.
If no new energy or security shock emerges, the overnight gap should become less dominant and the regime should remain low-Tail.
If futures continue to show meaningful counter-moves, mean reversion remains available and Tail should stay below WATCH.
If European participation does not create a fresh one-way extension, the base case remains low Tail with gradually easing Stress.
If Europe confirms balanced trade rather than directional efficiency, Tail should remain low even with persistent geopolitical uncertainty.
If yields, oil and technology leadership remain mixed rather than aligned, cross-asset conflict should restrain Tail conviction.
drivers: Technology leadership versus rates and oil

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket activity approaches, Tail can rise modestly if directional evidence strengthens, but remains low without repeated extension.
If the European-to-U.S. handoff remains orderly, Tail should stay low; a fresh aligned catalyst stack would be required for a sharper escalation.
drivers: Aligned catalyst stack remains a conditional risk

forecastDetail.comment: Closed NQ leaves Tail low; Gulf equity weakness raises Stress without live one-way NQ evidence.
Closed-market uncertainty persists; contained headlines keep Tail low while Stress remains extreme.
Contained geopolitical policy headlines would remain a Stress driver rather than proof of a pathological NQ path.
Unchanged China LPRs are expected to add little new directional pressure while NQ stays closed.
Resilient Gulf export routing is a partial supply offset; energy risk still keeps Stress elevated.
Reopening proximity raises conditional gap risk, but live gap and pullback evidence are still absent.
